data: Is the brown line in the left chart the highest at K = 3?

The brown line represents the performance of the model with transitive extensions of order K = 1, K = 2, K = 3, and K = ∗ when only learned features are used. The question asks if this brown line is the highest at K = 3.

Looking at the left chart (a), we can see that the brown line (P2, P3, P1, NP1, NP2) is not the highest at K = 3. At K = 3, the purple line (P2, P3, P1, NP1) is higher than the brown line. Therefore, the brown line is not the highest at K = 3.
